meta.title: Commissioned Oil Portraits | Rodrigo Normando
meta.description: Traditional art and commissioned portraits in Essen. Custom oil paintings, pencil, charcoal and watercolor by Rodrigo Normando.

about.experience: I am an artist with years of experience drawing with pencil, charcoal, and pens, as well as painting in oil and watercolor. I enjoy making portraits of people and animals, but I also work with landscapes. My passion for art motivates me to explore different techniques and styles, always striving to capture the beauty of the world around me. Currently I live and work in the city of Essen, Germany.
